release.title: Version 2.0.0 — The Iqa3 Major Upgrade 🎵
release.subtitle: Fresh new look, enhanced audio player, deep link navigation, and cross-platform polish
new_features: Brand new app icon across all platforms (Android, iOS, Windows, Mac, Web)
Custom splash screens for Android and Web with beautiful loading animations
Deep link navigation — share and open specific songs directly within the app
Waveform visualization with a scrolling display for visual audio feedback
Complete overhaul of the full player page with better controls and modern layout
Redesigned genre browsing interface for easier music discovery
Trending tracks section with improved recommendations
Enhanced track action menu with more intuitive options
Better track details and metadata handling
improvements: Search functionality is now faster and more accurate
Improved handling of track details from the API
App routing and navigation have been streamlined
Android app updates with manifest and resource adjustments
Cross-platform polish for a consistent experience everywhere
bug_fixes: Fixed several edge cases in player controls and track loading
Resolved minor UI glitches in genre pages and search results
Corrected deep link routing on specific device configurations
Improved stability when switching between tracks with waveform active

user_friendly_update_message: 🚀 Iqa3 2.0.0 is here — a massive upgrade! We’ve given the app a complete visual refresh with a new icon, custom splash screens, and a redesigned player page. Now you can share tracks via deep links, enjoy a scrolling waveform visualizer, discover music through revamped genre and trending sections, and experience smoother cross-platform performance on Android, iOS, Web, Windows, and Mac. This update also brings better search, improved track options, and under-the-hood enhancements to routing, notifications, and API handling. Update now for the best Iqa3 experience! 🎶
